[EN] It is my dream to collect and breed every mount in Arborea.

However, some very special ones are difficult to obtain on my own, so I am planning to purchasing them with passes from the Valkyon Federation.

I am collecting as many of them as possible since the number of pass required for each mount is very different.

If you get me ‘Special Mount Pass’,
which Valkyon Federation is issuing for a limited period of time,
I will give you the treasures I have collected so far in return!
[ES] Mi sueño es coleccionar y criar todas las monturas de Arborea.

Sin embargo, algunas muy especiales son difíciles de conseguir por mi cuenta, así que planeo comprarlas con pases de la Valkyon Federation.

Estoy recolectando tantos como sea posible, ya que la cantidad de pases requerida para cada montura es muy diferente.

Si me consigues el 'Special Mount Pass',
que la Valkyon Federation está emitiendo por tiempo limitado,
¡te daré los tesoros que he recolectado hasta ahora a cambio!
